Class GermanTaxDetail

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.germantax.GermanTaxDetail
public class GermanTaxDetail extends Object
One row of the derivation of the German tax report: a sale, an income or an advance lump sum with its amounts in euro, the exchange rate it was converted with and the purchases a sale consumed. It is the derivation and no second addend of a sum.
